Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Sales & eCommerce Operations Specialist position at Wolf Oil Corporation. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, SEO, and web analytics, combined with hands-on experience in e-commerce content management and data-driven reporting, I am excited about the opportunity to support your international growth and e-commerce ambitions.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, build and maintain WordPress sites, and track performance using tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs. I have also implemented structured data and technical audits on my own project, mirook.com, to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. My background includes front-end development, which gives me a technical edge in understanding and optimizing digital platforms.

I am eager to bring my analytical mindset, attention to detail, and proactive approach to your team. I am confident in my ability to build dashboards, manage CRM data, and support strategic decision-making.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Wolf Oil Corporation.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Sales & eCommerce Operations Specialist position at Wolf Oil Corporation. As a data-driven digital marketer with a technical foundation in web development and analytics, I am excited about the opportunity to support your international distribution networks and emerging e-commerce ambitions.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have developed a robust skill set in analytics and reporting. I regularly use Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs to track site performance and guide SEO and content decisions. I have also built and maintained client websites in WordPress, using Elementor and Astra, which has given me practical experience in e-commerce content management and platform optimization.

My own project, mirook.com, has been a sandbox for applying advanced technical SEO and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) techniques. I implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema), entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This hands-on experience has honed my ability to conduct market research, perform audits, and benchmark platforms—skills directly relevant to the e-commerce audits and platform benchmarking mentioned in your job description.

I am proficient in Excel and have a working knowledge of SQL, which I am eager to deepen. I am also comfortable with Power BI and Power Automate, and I am quick to learn new tools. My background in front-end development (AngularJS, JavaScript) gives me a technical edge in understanding and optimizing digital platforms.

I am particularly drawn to Wolf Oil Corporation's values of being connected, committed to excellence, and entrepreneurial. I thrive in collaborative environments and am proactive in identifying automation opportunities. I am confident that my analytical mindset, attention to detail, and can-do mentality would make me a valuable addition to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your growth and e-commerce initiatives.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
